what: membership inference against the training procedure, over shadow models
data: MedMNIST v2 BreastMNIST at 28 px, train and test splits (CC BY 4.0 as MedMNIST states it; the BUSI authors publish no licence; DATA_LICENSES.md), downsampled to 14 px as the students see them; the val split selects each student's epoch, as in training

teacher.held_fixed: every shadow student is distilled from the published teacher, which was trained on the train split, so membership in the teacher's training set is not audited here

label: the teacher's label, which is each student's training target and which anyone can compute from the published teacher

models.student: medical_fl.student: conv 1->4, ReLU, avg-pool, dense 196->16, ReLU, dense 16->2, the net-benefit cut folded into the head
models.square_student: medical_fl.square_student: conv 1->4, batch norm, x^2, avg-pool, dense 196->2

design.membership: complementary pairs: each record a member of exactly half the models

attacks.lira_online: Carlini et al., IEEE S&P 2022 (arXiv:2112.03570); implemented here
attacks.rmia_offline: Zarifzadeh, Liu and Shokri, ICML 2024 (arXiv:2312.03262); implemented here and checked against ML Privacy Meter's run_rmia at e384af8fd931

not_resolvable: fpr 0.001: 0.0106 of non-members tie at the top score
fpr 0.01: 0.0106 of non-members tie at the top score
fpr 0.001: 0.0102 of non-members tie at the top score
fpr 0.01: 0.0102 of non-members tie at the top score

reading: TPR at a fixed low FPR is the measure; an AUC near 0.5 with TPR near the FPR means the attack learns little about membership from this model's outputs. An attack gives a lower bound on leakage, not a proof of its absence.
